scripts.backend:docker:up: docker compose up -d --build postgres-ru postgres-dubai backend-ru backend-dubai
scripts.backend:docker:ru:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.ru.yml up -d --build postgres-ru backend-ru
scripts.backend:docker:dubai:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.dubai.yml up -d --build postgres-dubai backend-dubai
scripts.backend:docker:logs: docker compose logs -f backend-ru backend-dubai postgres-ru postgres-dubai
scripts.backend:docker:ru:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.ru.yml logs -f backend-ru postgres-ru
scripts.backend:docker:dubai:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.dubai.yml logs -f backend-dubai postgres-dubai
scripts.backend:build: npm run backend:ru:build && npm run backend:dubai:build
scripts.backend:typecheck: npm run backend:ru:typecheck && npm run backend:dubai:typecheck
scripts.backend:test: npm run backend:ru:test && npm run backend:dubai:test
